messages:
deploybot: PROMOTE_HOLD: release-window blocked for v1.47.0 1/4 artifact fetches returned truncated bodies (size mismatch). Auto-promo paused. See /ci/4280.
Hannah: which artifact? server wheel or shared lib?
ci-bot: failing step: artifact-verify for server-wheel-1.47.0.whl. Mirrors report different sizes.
Omar: logs show PUT returned 200 but Content-Length differs on mirror-b (short by ~1MB). Could be storage client write-timeout + retry writing partial object.
Hannah: change window ends in 22m. Options: reupload+rerun CI (~18m) or pin last-stable v1.46.8 and promote. Thoughts?
ReleaseManager: prefer reupload once; if it fails again, pin to keep SLAs. Approve one retry.
Omar: kicking republish with single-threaded upload + post-upload sha check. Command: `./scripts/publish --file wheel --verify-sha256`
deploybot: Auto-promo remains BLOCKED until artifact integrity verified across mirrors. Manual promote allowed with ReleaseManager approval token.
ci-bot: rerun started by Omar (pipeline 4281). ETA ~10m.
infra-bot: noted elevated put-retry counts on storage nodes in eu-central-1; opened INFRA-489.
ci-bot: pipeline 4281: artifact-verify PASSED. Mirrors reported matching sizes and sha256. Staging smoke run starting.
Hannah: good. Let's do a 2% canary for 10m and monitor artifact restore metrics.
ReleaseManager: agree. Can also delay full promote by 10m to ensure stability.
deploybot: Canary launched (2%). Smoke window 10m.
ci-bot: canary smoke passed 9m. No truncate errors on canary nodes.
Hannah: proceeding to roll out. Will document follow-up: INFRA-489 investigate storage client retry behavior causing partial writes.
ReleaseManager: promote completed. Manual override not needed. Auto-promo remains BLOCKED until INFRA-489 resolved and storage put success rate >99.5% for 1h.
Omar: adding a guard in uploader to verify object size after final PUT and retry if mismatch. I'll open a small PR.
Hannah: release notes: "Promoted v1.47.0 after republish due to transient partial writes causing truncated artifacts; follow-up: uploader size-verify + infra investigation."
ReleaseManager: closing hold for window. Thanks team :thumbsup:
